description: Projects stored receipt verification evidence. verified is true only when the stored payload HMAC was cryptographically checked and a provider GET readback matched the uploaded artifact; this call does not perform a fresh provider lookup.

filecoin_cid.description: Optional Filecoin CID to verify directly, instead of looking it up by run ID.

run_id.description: Run ID of the receipt to verify.

name: yax_verify_receipt

anchor_exists.description: Legacy field tightened to true only when provider GET readback matched content, not merely when a CID exists.

filecoin_cid.description: Stored Filecoin reference, which may exist even when readback is unverified.

signature_ok.description: Whether HMAC verification of the stored receipt payload passed; a prefix alone does not count.

verified.description: True only when stored digest, HMAC verification, and provider readback/content-match evidence all pass.

verified_at.description: Recorded provider-readback verification time; null when unverified.
